course.title: Cybersecurity Foundations for New Professionals
course.audience: New cybersecurity professionals, technology staff, risk owners, and business partners
course.description: An original Obserra Academy foundation course that develops practical cybersecurity judgment, identity protection habits, incident reporting discipline, and risk-aware decision making for professionals entering security-related roles.
outcomes: Explain core cybersecurity responsibilities using clear business and risk language.
Recognize common identity, data, endpoint, and social-engineering threats.
Apply proportionate escalation and incident-reporting decisions in realistic workplace scenarios.
Distinguish preventive, detective, responsive, and recovery controls.
Document accountable next actions after identifying a security concern.

modules.title: Security and Business Risk
modules.description: Connect cybersecurity responsibilities to business operations, people, data, trust, and organizational resilience.

modules.title: Identity, Access, and Authentication
modules.description: Apply secure identity habits, least privilege, multifactor authentication, and safe access decisions.

modules.title: Threat Recognition and Safe Response
modules.description: Recognize phishing, social engineering, malicious files, unsafe requests, and indicators requiring escalation.

modules.title: Incident Reporting and Evidence Preservation
modules.description: Practice timely reporting, factual documentation, evidence preservation, and responsible communication.

modules.title: Applied Cybersecurity Foundations Assessment
modules.description: Demonstrate practical judgment across identity, threat recognition, escalation, control selection, and incident response.
